_readme: 人工策展层。sync 只覆盖 catalog/model-registry.snapshot.json，本文件跨同步持久，脚本只读不写。
语言规则：why 与 when 会逐字渲染进分发给用户的产物，必须写英文；rationale / _readme / notes 不进产物，维持中文。
fallback_notes 同样逐字渲染进产物，必须写英文。
job_type 必须从快照逐字节复制：含空格与命名错位都是生产真实取值，不得规范化。
stability=stable 的规则在同步时静默继承；stability=review 的会被列入待确认清单。
tier 为人工标注，registry 无此字段；unknown 表示尚未与产品/服务端确认。
产品只有两种免费模式：free（免费，页面徒章 Ltd Free）与 vip_free（VIP 免费，页面徒章 VIP FREE）。不得自行发明第三种档位。
HOT / NEW / xx% OFF 是运营与计价标签，不是权限档位，不得映射成 tier。
fallback_notes: The image-to-image `From` column is the member default. Section 3 already routes a non-member to `image2image_media_1.0`, which is the fallback target itself, so for them there is nothing cheaper to switch to — offer credits or a membership instead of proposing another downgrade.

featured.why: Default for pure text-to-image. text2image_media_3.0 does not exist in production; this is the free entry point that returns an image directly. Display name is ToMoviee Lite.
Default for image-to-image. First choice for character consistency, outfit control and character editing. Free for members; non-members are charged.
Member-free alternative to ToMoviee 3.0 Pro. Prefer it when a member wants another free option; non-members are charged.
Fallback target for image-to-image, and the free option in this module. Retry with this when permission or credits are insufficient. Display name is ToMoviee Lite.

Newest GPT Image generation, quality-first variant. Pick it when the user asks for the best achievable quality or names Sunburst. A bare `GPT Image 2.5` is ambiguous between the two variants — list both and let the user choose.

Newest GPT Image generation, speed-first variant (display name GPT Image 2.5 Flare). Pick it when the user wants a strong everyday image quickly or names Flare. Note the job_type has no `_flare` suffix.
Newest GPT Image generation with a reference image, quality-first variant. Pick it for precise, instruction-faithful edits to an existing image, or when the user names Sunburst.

Newest GPT Image generation with a reference image, speed-first variant (display name GPT Image 2.5 Flare). Pick it for fast everyday edits or when the user names Flare. Note the job_type has no `_flare` suffix.
Previous GPT Image generation. Use when text must be rendered accurately inside the image, or the composition is unusually complex.
Previous GPT Image generation. Use with a reference image when text must be rendered accurately.
Anime, illustration and creative styles. Note the display name is Nano Banana Pro, not Nano Banana 2.
Anime and creative styles with a reference image. Display name is Nano Banana Pro.
Default for video. Use it whenever there is no special requirement.
Fallback target for video. Use it when the user wants speed or lower cost, or when permission/credits are insufficient.
Long video, audio included, cinematic quality. The job_type contains one space; that is the real production value.
Multi-reference video generation (up to 50 reference images); belongs to the reference2video module.
Strong physical simulation: shattering, fluids, collisions.
Text-to-video with natively synchronized audio and spoken dialogue at 2K. The job_type ends in `_switch`; the older suffix-less name is offline.
Fastest MiniMax H3 tier for text-to-video: native HD with synchronized audio and dialogue, sub-realtime inference. Unlike the plain H3 entry this job_type has no `_switch` suffix.
Image-to-video with natively synchronized audio and spoken dialogue at 2K. Its starting-image parameter is `--init_image`, not the `--images` used by most video models.
Fastest MiniMax H3 tier for image-to-video: native HD with synchronized audio and dialogue, sub-realtime inference. Also takes `--init_image`, and the job_type has no `_switch` suffix.
Multi-reference video with synchronized audio and dialogue; belongs to the reference2video module even though the job_type carries an image2video prefix. Takes repeated `--images`.

text2image.when: The user names GPT Image 2.5 Sunburst, or asks for the best achievable image quality regardless of speed
text2image.rationale: 2026-09 上线的 GPT Image 2.5 质量档；registry 描述 Exceptional quality, precise edits。

text2image.when: The user names GPT Image 2.5 Flare, or wants a strong everyday image with the fastest turnaround
text2image.rationale: 2026-09 上线的 GPT Image 2.5 速度档；registry 描述 Stunning everyday images, fast。job_type 无 _flare 后缀。

text2image.when: Text must be rendered accurately in the image, or the composition is unusually complex
text2image.rationale: V0.5 需求文档指定的文字渲染与复杂构图档。
V0.5 需求文档指定的创意风格档；显示名 Nano Banana Pro。
免费兜底，且不分会员等级：纯文生图只有 ToMoviee Lite 一档，生产无 text2image_media_3.0，也不能落到 image2image 上。

image2image.when: The user names GPT Image 2.5 Sunburst, or asks for precise, instruction-faithful edits at the best achievable quality
image2image.rationale: 与 text2image 同档位，仅输入形态不同。

image2image.when: The user names GPT Image 2.5 Flare, or wants a fast everyday edit of the reference image
image2image.rationale: 与 text2image 同档位，仅输入形态不同；job_type 无 _flare 后缀。

image2image.when: Text must be rendered accurately in the image, or the composition is unusually complex
image2image.rationale: 与 text2image 同档位，仅输入形态不同。
V0.5 需求文档指定的创意风格档；显示名 Nano Banana Pro。

image2image.when: Everything else, including character consistency, outfit swap and character editing, AND `account status` reports a membership `level` of `standard` or `premium`
image2image.rationale: V0.5 需求文档的图像全局默认 ToMoviee 3.0 Pro；该档对会员免费（tier vip_free）。

image2image.when: Everything else, including character consistency, outfit swap and character editing, AND the account is not a member or the membership level is unknown
image2image.rationale: 非会员用 ToMoviee 3.0 Pro 会扣费，而 ToMoviee Lite 对所有人免费（tier free），因此默认推荐 Lite；用户明确要更好效果时再抬到 3.0 Pro 并走扣费确认。

video.when: Several reference images AND the user names MiniMax H3, or wants synchronized dialogue and audio driven by multiple references
video.rationale: 必须排在通用多参考规则之前，否则点名 H3 + 多参考图时永远落到 Seedance。属 reference2video 模块，job_type 却以 image2video_ 开头。

video.when: Multi-modal reference with several reference images
video.rationale: 唯一支持多参考图的档位，属 reference2video 模块。

video.when: A single starting image AND the user names MiniMax H3 Max, or wants synchronized dialogue with the fastest turnaround
video.rationale: H3 提速档；起始图参数是 --init_image。

video.when: A single starting image AND the user names MiniMax H3, or wants native 2K video with synchronized dialogue and audio
video.rationale: H3 图生视频主档；起始图参数是 --init_image。旧的 image2video_minimax_h3 已下线。

video.when: No input image AND the user names MiniMax H3 Max, or wants synchronized dialogue with the fastest turnaround
video.rationale: H3 文生视频提速档；job_type 无 _switch 后缀。

video.when: No input image AND the user names MiniMax H3, or wants native 2K video with synchronized dialogue and audio
video.rationale: H3 文生视频主档，也是 video 槽位里唯一的纯文生视频入口。旧的 text2video_minimax_h3 已下线。

video.when: Long video (around 30s), audio needed, or cinematic quality
video.rationale: V0.5 需求文档指定的长视频与电影级档；job_type 含空格。H3 规则排在前面，带人声对白的诉求先被 H3 接走。

video.when: Strong physical simulation: shattering, fluids, collisions
video.rationale: V0.5 需求文档指定的物理模拟档。

video.when: User explicitly asks for speed or lower cost
video.rationale: V0.5 需求文档指定的提速档，同时是非 VIP 的主降级目标。
V0.5 需求文档的视频全局默认 ToMoviee 3.0。

notes: tier 证据来源：2026-08-31 media.io『AI 图像』模型下拉列表截图（图生图 / 文生图 两个 tab 的完整列表），逐条读取徽章。
图生图列表带 VIP FREE 的只有两条：ToMoviee 3.0 Pro（image2image_media_3.0）、ToMoviee Pro (ex-Media 2.0)（image2image_media_2.0）。文生图列表无任何 VIP FREE。
ToMoviee Lite 在两个 tab 都带 Ltd Free 徒章，即产品口径的『免费』，对应 text2image_soul_character 与 image2image_media_1.0，均标 free。
Nano Banana Pro 在两个 tab 都只有 HOT 徽章，无 VIP FREE，故 text2image_banana_2 / image2image_banana_2 均为 unknown（HOT 是热度标签）。上一版曾误标 vip_free，已按截图撤回。
视频模块为『已查未见』而非『未查证』：页面仅有折扣标签，无任何 VIP FREE 或 Ltd Free 标记，故 image2video / text2video / reference2video 全部维持 unknown。
折扣百分比（50% / 28% / 60% 等）不进入 tier：tier 只表达免费档位语义，折扣是计价细节，一律以 generate estimate 为准。
未带免费徒章的模型目前统一留 unknown：它们应当是正常扣积分的模型，但枚举里没有表达『收费』的值，暂不自行新增。
GPT Image 2.5（2026-09 上线）两个变体的 job_type 与显示名错位：Flare 是 *_gpt_image_2.5（无 _flare 后缀），Sunburst 是 *_gpt_image_2.5_sunburst。两者在 registry 的 tier 字段均为 paid，本文件按既有口径记 unknown。
MiniMax H3（2026-09 换代）：旧的 image2video_minimax_h3 / _head_and_tail / _reference_image 与 text2video_minimax_h3 已从生产下线，替换为带 _switch 后缀的同名档；但 *_minimax_h3_max 两条没有 _switch 后缀。六条在 registry 的 tier 均为 paid。
image2video_minimax_h3_head_and_tail_switch（首尾帧档，显示名同为 MiniMax H3）未进精选：它的输入形态是首帧+尾帧，与本次需求的文生/图生/参考生三类都不同，需要时再从全量索引取。
页面列表中的 Seedream 5.0 Pro / Seedream 5.0 Lite / Seedream 4.0 / Wan 2.7 Pro / Wan 2.7 / Nano Banana 均已在 registry 快照中命中，页面与快照无缺口；这些条目未带免费徽章，维持 unknown。
页面标签随地区、登录态、会员态与活动变化，本文件记录的是取证当时的快照，不是长期承诺。
tier 标为 unknown 的条目尚未确认权限等级；实际是否扣费以 generate estimate 与服务端结果为准。
